visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straightened light-brown hair and vibrant pink lipstick looks directly at the camera, posing in what appears to be an indoor setting with a brown leather background. (2) She shifts her head slightly and touches her temple with her finger, showcasing her groomed eyebrows and eye makeup while maintaining a neutral, soft expression. (3) The scene cuts to a stark post-operative image of her face; she has numerous stitches across her forehead, significant bruising around her eyes, and beige medical tape applied to her jaw and cheeks. (4) A extreme close-up depicts a medical procedure being performed on her nose, where a pair of tweezers is seen carefully removing or adjusting materials near the nostril area over white gauze. (5) The final phase shows her in a studio-like environment, fully made-up with a dramatic evening look, wearing large diamond-style earrings and a gold sequined top as a stylist in the background works on her hair with a spray bottle.
